sources.imageDate: Unknown; image URL directory February 2024 is not an exposure date.
sources.observed: Project text establishes 366 ft height, 516 ft width, plaza and Venetian bridge arrivals, second-level atrium, four seating tiers and two suite levels. Facts table conflicts with narrative at 336 ft; retain 366 ft corroborated by SEC filing.

images.observed: Visually inspected: curved stacked balcony edges, tall cylindrical columns with glowing caps, suspended rings, paired escalators, glazed balustrades, reflective dark floor. Installed atrium retains these broad motifs but is simplified; exact alignment is not established.
Visually inspected: rounded display shell over a low dark entrance base; visible triangular panel structure, repeated glazed entrance bays and hardscape. Event display imagery not reproduced.

sources.observed: Corroborates 366 ft height and 516 ft width.

Confirms East and West entries from Sands Avenue and accessible Venetian bridge via the resort; elevators and escalators exist. Does not establish exact architectural dimensions or a complete floor plan.

dimensions.heightBasis: 366 ft and 516 ft converted at 0.3048; existing generator already uses these dimensions.
dimensions.placement: Mapped plan and existing datum retained; elevations, portal clearances and interior room arrangement are authoring approximations, not a survey.

implemented: Existing authored exterior display shell and low arrival base retained.
Existing plaza, west entry, bridge threshold, atrium, escalators and four-tier seating bowl retained.
Separate adjoining garage/service components belong to sphere-garage.json (way/111339081 and way/1001560970); their existing reconstruction is not a new Sphere addition.
remaining: Fine facade fidelity remains open: display panel seams, entrance bay rhythm, canopy and hardscape need matched current ground/aerial reference coverage before a justified mesh change.
Full Venetian-to-Sphere connection remains open: a local bridge threshold test does not establish the entire inter-property route.

Public interior alignment, suite levels, accessible lifts and complete seat capacity remain approximate; existing generated 10394 seats are below the architect’s 17600-seat description and must not be called exact.
Historical blank adjoining-component finding is partly superseded by the separate sphere-garage record; remaining unowned background shells still require a current ownership inventory.
Baseline plaza p95 is 59.7 ms at 960x540 DPR1 ultra, while other sampled views are 17.7–19.3 ms. Existing performance limitation requires diagnosis; no sustained 60 fps claim.
Maps/Street View comparison and full perimeter walk are still pending for this pass.

validation.collision: Existing sphere test passed 5879 support/body and 6 door checks with 11 city cells; actual movement is a separate pending check.
validation.visual: Six baseline installed views inspected; front first. Bridge framing is close to a brace, bowl view emphasizes screen, and neither proves the complete bridge or seating layout.
validation.performance: Baseline six stationary views, 900 warm frames plus streaming quiet, 60 settle frames and 180 measured frames; dynamic original screen content makes pixel-identical comparisons inappropriate.

decisions: Preserve existing geometry and optimized runtime while establishing a durable inventory and explicit remaining work. No speculative geometry or third-party texture copying.
Treat current event admission rules as operations, not permanent architecture.
